## Description {#details}

Struct template for compile-time type identity.

<ParametersList title="Template Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="T">The type to be preserved.</ParametersListItem>
<ParametersListItem name="...Unused">Additional template parameters, ignored.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>
The <code>identity</code> struct template provides a mechanism for preserving a type <code>T</code> during template metaprogramming. It is commonly used to delay type evaluation or to forward types in complex template constructs within the µTest++ framework.

This utility is particularly useful in scenarios where type deduction or SFINAE is required, as it allows the type to be carried through template specialisations without modification.
